messages:
emily_cs: Quick heads-up — Northbridge renewal is in 9 days. They requested a term change (12 -> 24 months) and +10 seats. Pricing team asked for a refreshed quote.
emily_cs: Current blocker: procurement needs a PO number before DocuSign will accept the signature. Customer said finance is on a spending freeze until Monday.
andre_sales: Thanks Emily. Do we have an approved discount for 24m? I remember we can do up to 18% for multi-year + seats but need manager signoff for anything higher.
emily_cs: I left a note in the deal doc: allowed discount band 12-18%. They asked for 20% verbally.
sam_finance: If they push 20% we'll need exec approval. Can you share the ARR delta and renewal ARR in a one-liner? I can run quick impact calc.
emily_cs: Renewal ARR before seats: $95,000. +10 seats = +$12,000. At 18% discount new ARR ~ $87,960 (annualized). At 20% ~ $85,600.
anya_legal: Any contract language changes? Term extension ok, auto-renew to match 24m? Also SSO/PSC questions from their security team?
emily_cs: Security already ok with SSO. Legal asked to add a short clause about data residency — they require EU-only storage for this customer. Need to confirm which deployment they use.
jess_northbridge: (customer) Hi team — confirming finance is out until Monday. We can provide the PO then. Can you send an updated quote + order form to route to our procurement? Prefer DocuSign for signatures.
emily_cs: Got it. I'll request updated quote now. Andre, can you approve a one-time 18% discount so we can keep momentum?
andre_sales: Approve 18% to close before EOM. I’ll escalate for 20% if they push but plan for 18.
emily_cs: Thanks. Sam — FYI, 18% ok from sales. Any internal billing flags for 24m with EU-only residency?
sam_finance: EU-only will change billing metadata and might need different VAT handling. I'll flag with billing ops, ticket #BILL-4782. Shouldn't block PO acceptance but may change invoice contacts.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a1b2c). Status: waiting for signer (jess_northbridge). Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0a1b2c
emily_cs: I attached the draft order form snippet below (internal fields redacted):
```
Customer: Northbridge Analytics
Term: 24 months
Seats: 110 (100 existing + 10 add)
List ARR: $107,000
Discount: 18%
Net ARR: $87,740
Billing: EU-only residency, monthly invoice
```
emily_cs: Next steps: 1) Andre send updated quote + order form to customer by EOD today. 2) Jess to get PO Monday. 3) Sam to confirm billing metadata before invoicing. 4) Anya to prep minimal language for EU residency clause.
anya_legal: I'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum and attach to the order form. Should be quick.
jess_northbridge: Thanks — we'll aim to send PO Mon morning. If finance needs more justification, any exec note from sales would help.
andre_sales: Will send quote in 1 hour and include a short justification email addressed to their CFO.
emily_cs: I'll schedule the onboarding kickoff for the week after signature; include enablement checklist so they can budget resource allocation.
sam_finance: FYI — if PO arrives Monday, billing ops can process invoice by Wednesday. I’ll cc billing contact on the DocuSign when envelope is completed to speed things.
emily_cs: Perfect. I'll follow up Monday morning and ping here. :thumbsup:
andre_sales: Thanks everyone.
jess_northbridge: Appreciate the help.
emily_cs: (reminder) tagging @andre_sales @sam_finance @anya_legal — confirm when quote/email sent.
andre_sales: Sent — quote emailed at 1799991800, attached order form, cc'd CFO.
anyac: small typo fix on the addendum — will re-upload by EOD.
anya_legal: Uploaded addendum v1.1 to the DocuSign envelope and notified customer.
docusign-bot: Envelope env_0a1b2c status updated: sent to signer.
emily_cs: Closing loop — Jess said procurement will submit PO Monday afternoon. Reopening thread if anything slips. Thanks team!"
